T1_constant: Native-minus-constant balanced mean Y-PSNR >=0.05 dB; both fixed seeds positive; Bonferroni-adjusted 97.5% paired-image CI excludes0 in positive direction.
T1_shuffle: Native-minus-shuffle(native inference) same criterion, forming a family of two primary comparisons.
T2_constant: Constant and no-cell equivalent within +/-0.03 dB: 95% paired-image CI wholly inside equivalence margin; two TOST comparisons Bonferroni alpha0.025 each.
T2_shuffle: Shuffle(native inference) and no-cell same equivalence criterion. Failure of equivalence is reported as failure/inconclusive, never interpreted as proof of difference or equivalence.
recovery: Descriptive predeclared regions u<0.75, [0.75,1), [1,2), >=2; all quarter-u bins retained, paired CIs reported. No success-bin selection or additional gate.
